title: Working line: the bot's mark and what it is doing now
evidence: Working line in Transcript.tsx + styles.css: row 180 ms, mark 340 ms spring, label 180 ms (+220 ms first), shimmer steps(60) 2.2 s, face squash and tilt, exit 140 ms. Starts with the mark alone, like the oracle; "Typing…" while text streams (not for text that lands within a frame). Gate B: "replied" and the exit inside budget on 3 turns. The row comes with the bot's Working state (Barkpark's fleet stream, event: state), as the oracle's comes with its rail's Working: storage's row 0.8 s after "is working" now matches (Gate B working#1, 2016 vs 2014 ms; a row ignoring the state fails it, early by 776 ms). The rail's Working is judged as its own Gate B moment (rail:working, within 3 ms on 3 turns); driving it from the turn's start instead fails storage, early by 777 ms. Tool labels: a host with item events (task-f13fc4b4dc2af6de) sends each tool call with its name and input, and the line says it (Bash's description, else the tool). Missing: the oracle's summary labels ("Saying hello", "Writing a greeting", "Checking system storage") are its own summaries of the turn: say-hi and say-hi-2 call no tool, so no host event can carry them.
